[issue by rytlebsk] ### Description When a Funnel is connected to a Packager, items are incorrectly extracted from an Item Vault while a Minecart Assembler is assembling a minecart. The items inside the Item Vault are automatically extracted even though they have not been packaged and were not requested by any packaging or logistics operation. ### Game Log https://mclo.gs/nvF4hx9 ### Debug Information
